<!--
  THE CANVAS — `Each page is its own canvas`, Act 3 (Modularity).

  ONE CLICK, AND ONLY THE INSIDE OF THE CARD MOVES. The stack is the same size
  throughout: at rest it is qmd-stack.qmd's `.qmd x 15` — the object the room
  has already seen three times — with its teal `yaml` band and its yellow
  `content` band, drawn big. Click 1 swaps the front card's interior and
  nothing else: the two source bands go, and a PAGE arrives in their place —
  chrome dots, the sidebar Quarto wrote, and one yellow code chunk in the body.

  Holding the size fixed is the point. An earlier cut grew the stack on the
  click and it pulled the eye to the wrong thing; the claim is not that the
  page gets bigger, it is that the card you write in and the page you get are
  the same rectangle, and all you put in it is chunks. Frame constant, contents
  swap.

  THE HEADING TURNS OVER ON THE SAME BEAT. `Each page is its own canvas` fades
  out and the `...all you need is code chunks!` chip fades in, in the same
  place — `.canvashead` in custom.css grids the two into one cell so they
  overlap instead of stacking, which is what keeps this figure's slot as tall
  as it is. Both are `data-fragment-index="1"`, so heading and card turn over
  together.

  COORDINATES ARE qmd-stack's x2.1 (card 190x124 -> 400x260, the 8-unit fan
  -> 17, stroke 2.5 -> 5), then offset by (-80, -18) so the viewBox origin is
  (0, 0). ⚠️ At 72vh the card renders ~700px wide against qmd-stack.qmd's
  ~305px, so this is emphatically not that figure at that scale — it is the
  same drawing enlarged to carry a slide on its own.

  "0 0 440 372": ink is x 20..420 (centre 220) and y ~15..356 (centre 185.5) —
  the top edge is the 44px label's ascender at y=47, not the back card at y=62.
  Box centre is (220, 186). Keep the ink centred on it, and keep the origin at
  (0, 0), if a CSS transform is ever put back on a group in here: browsers
  disagree about whether `transform-origin` percentages resolve against the
  viewBox's min-x/min-y or against (0, 0), and a non-zero origin makes the two
  readings pivot around different points.

  `display: block` on the <svg> is deliberate — inline, it drags a ~10px
  baseline descender along underneath and the bottom margin stops being
  predictable.

  Yellow is a FILL only — the content band, then the code chunk that replaces
  it. Text on yellow is navy, text on teal is white. Backticks are &#96; so the
  ```{=html} fence can never be in doubt.
-->

```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 440 372" width="70%" style="display:block;margin:1.5em auto 0;max-height:50vh;"
     xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     font-family="'Fira Sans Condensed', Tahoma, sans-serif">

  <text x="220" y="47" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#2e4057" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">.qmd &#215; 15</text>

  <!-- Back cards first, flush right at 420, fanning up-left in 17s. -->
  <rect x="54" y="62" width="366" height="260" rx="13"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="5"/>
  <rect x="37" y="79" width="383" height="260" rx="13"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="5"/>
  <rect x="20" y="96" width="400" height="260" rx="13"
        fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="5"/>

  <!-- ── AT REST: the source bands, qmd-stack's exactly ──────────────── -->
  <g class="fragment fade-out" data-fragment-index="1">
    <rect x="54" y="130" width="332" height="76" fill="#00798c"/>
    <text x="220" y="183" font-size="42" text-anchor="middle"
          fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">yaml</text>
    <rect x="54" y="230" width="332" height="92" fill="#edae49"/>
    <text x="220" y="291" font-size="42" text-anchor="middle"
          fill="#2e4057" font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">content</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ── CLICK 1: the same rectangle, now a page ──────────────────────
       Occupies the bands' exact footprint (54,130 to 386,322) so the swap
       reads as one thing becoming another rather than two things trading
       places. -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
    <rect x="54" y="130" width="332" height="192" rx="8"
          fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M 54 166 L 386 166" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <circle cx="78" cy="148" r="6" fill="#2e4057"/>
    <circle cx="100" cy="148" r="6" fill="#2e4057"/>
    <circle cx="122" cy="148" r="6" fill="#2e4057"/>

    <!-- The sidebar is _quarto.yml's, the same one the two slides before this
         put on screen as yaml. You did not write it. -->
    <path d="M 152 166 L 152 322" stroke="#2e4057" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <rect x="71" y="184" width="58" height="8" fill="#2e4057"/>
    <rect x="71" y="203" width="58" height="8" fill="#2e4057"/>
    <rect x="71" y="222" width="58" height="8" fill="#2e4057"/>
    <rect x="71" y="241" width="58" height="8" fill="#2e4057"/>

    <!-- The one thing you DID write. Centred in the body at (269, 244). -->
    <rect x="171" y="190" width="196" height="108" rx="4" fill="#edae49"/>
    <text x="187" y="220" font-size="22" fill="#2e4057"
          font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">&#96;&#96;&#96;{r}</text>
    <text x="187" y="248" font-size="22" fill="#2e4057"
          font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">plot(df)</text>
    <text x="187" y="276" font-size="22" fill="#2e4057"
          font-family="SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace">&#96;&#96;&#96;</text>
  </g>

</svg>
```
